sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: A wholesaler mainly buys goods in bulk from producers and sells them to…

options.A: final consumers only in every case

questions.explanation: Wholesalers commonly sell bulk goods to retailers and other businesses.

questions.question: The principle of indemnity is intended to…

options.B: restore the insured to a similar financial position, subject to the policy

questions.explanation: Indemnity aims to compensate an insured loss within policy terms, not create profit.

questions.question: A cheque is an instruction to a bank to…

options.B: pay a specified amount from an account, subject to conditions

questions.explanation: A cheque is a payment order drawn on a bank account, subject to valid presentation.

questions.question: One major function of advertising is to…
questions.explanation: Advertising informs audiences about products and can attempt to persuade them.

questions.question: A document acknowledging receipt of goods or payment is commonly a…
questions.explanation: A receipt records that goods or payment have been received.

questions.question: What is the main role of a wholesaler in a distribution channel?

options.D: Buying in bulk and reselling in smaller quantities to retailers

questions.explanation: Wholesalers buy in bulk and supply retailers or other businesses.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A retailer usually sells goods to whom?
questions.explanation: Retailers sell goods to final consumers.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Gross profit is generally sales revenue less what?
questions.explanation: Gross profit is sales minus cost of goods sold.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The principle of indemnity aims to do what?

options.A: Restore the insured to a similar financial position after a covered loss

questions.explanation: Indemnity compensates covered loss rather than creating a profit.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: What is the principal commercial use of warehousing?

options.D: Storing goods until they are needed for sale or use

questions.explanation: Warehouses help balance supply timing and demand.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Branding helps a business mainly by doing what?
questions.explanation: Branding builds product identity and differentiation.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: An entrepreneur is a person who primarily does what?

options.B: Organises a venture and bears business risk

questions.explanation: Entrepreneurs organise resources and assume business risk.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: An invoice usually records which information?

options.A: Goods or services supplied and the amount payable

questions.explanation: An invoice documents a sale and amount due.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which service allows customers to make electronic payments between accounts?
questions.explanation: Electronic transfers move funds between accounts.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The main purpose of advertising is to do what?

options.B: Remove the need for product quality
options.C: Inform or persuade an intended audience about an offer

questions.explanation: Advertising communicates product information and may persuade customers.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Stocktaking is the process of doing what?
questions.explanation: Stocktaking checks actual inventory against records.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: A genuine product warranty mainly states what?

options.A: Conditions under which the seller or maker will remedy certain faults
options.B: The product will never fail under any conditions

questions.explanation: A warranty states defined promises and remedy conditions.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which transport mode is often suitable for moving large bulk goods over long inland distances at low unit cost?
questions.explanation: Rail can move heavy bulk cargo efficiently over land.

questions.question: E-commerce is commercial activity conducted through what?

options.C: Electronic networks such as the internet

questions.explanation: E-commerce includes online buying and selling.
